player_actions: Shiki stands up, exits adjacent meditation room into ICU security corridor, closely stares at male courier.
Orders courier to stand still and not make sudden movements.

Extends hand to Kuroda asking for suspect transfer documents, receives and examines them as delivered. Shiki does not strike/attack/search/interrogate patient, claim personal emotion, or leave hospital.

timeline.visible: Ritsu confirms SMALL sterile aliquot of UNIDENTIFIED continuous IV medicine was sent to hospital laboratory for identification and potential effect on neuromuscular transmission; results NOT available. Main infusion remains running UNINTERRUPTED, a spare dose remains supervised and NOT administered. Ritsu would require clinical justification before additional dosing. Med group autonomously monitors ventilation.

Player-controlled Shiki rises from meditation and comes to ICU outer corridor, sharply watches waiting short male courier in gray admin uniform with ID badge, orders 'Вы стоите и не дёргаетесь'. Courier is visibly frightened, fingers tremble and gaze can't remain fixed, but obeys and stays with arms down. Kuroda stays close to his own weapon, maintains exit control, no violence or magical fear compulsion assumed. Shiki asks 'Дайте документы', stretches hand to Kuroda; Kuroda places ORIGINAL documents into clear evidence sleeve, time and courier identity logged, hands them to Shiki.

Two-page physical paper apparent Kusa medical-administration urgent patient transfer order, document number EXACT КМУ-19/472, dated 1283-09-22, purported issued at EXACT 18:42 (BEFORE hospital admission at18:56). Sent from Kusa Central Hospital to 'Исследовательский корпус № 3', reason special medical observation, receiving physician NOT named, breathing support arrangements missing, official signature unreadable. Second sheet asserts 'Специальное лекарственное сопровождение при переводе не требуется'. Ritsu notes if followed literally, dangerous risk of withdrawal from unknown infusion and no respiratory support. Kuroda remarks predated admission alone not proof of forgery, but hospital registry has NO such number, which is serious. Apparent stamp is not proven counterfeit or genuine.

When Kuroda asks who gave him case, courier claims unknown WOMAN in DARK uniform wearing medical-administration pass gave case at internal COURIER ROOM, says she instructed that if ward refused transfer, return case and do not revisit. These are courier's unverified statements; courier not confirmed complicit and remains in Kusa security custody without active resistance. Kuroda instructs officer to inspect courier room log and identify described woman, submit photocopy to internal security, maintain security, guard entrance. Ritsu reiterates NO patient transfer without established authority, named receiving clinician and safe respiration/drug provision. Medical nurse confirms patient stable, ventilator and unknown IV still functioning. Patient not further interrogated and no new attack.
